description: This file defines the ObjectUploader class which handles uploading objects to Amazon S3, supporting both simple and multipart uploads.

classes.name: ObjectUploader
classes.description: Handles uploading objects to Amazon S3, with support for multipart uploads based on object size.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ObjectUploader with an S3 client, target bucket, key, body, ACL, and options.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a PromiseInterface that performs the upload (multipart or regular) asynchronously.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Performs the upload synchronously by waiting on the promise.

methods.name: requiresMultipart
methods.description: Determines if the upload should be multipart based on body size and threshold; may modify the body stream accordingly.
